title: Shocking Conspiracy
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's counter-strategy gradually unfolded, the remnants of the Five Elders and the Demonic Path Commander had already seen through his layout—who is the true chess master in this game?

text.content: The smell of scorched earth permeated the battlefield. Chen Ji's gaze meeting those pitch-black eyes seemed to freeze time. The sounds of fighting and spiritual light explosions around became distant and blurred, leaving only that familiar, heart-piercing gaze—like a venomous snake flicking its tongue, carving a cold mark deep into his soul. Beneath the Demonic Path Commander's black纱 cloak, that obscured face seemed to evoke some long-buried memory. Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly, but he forced himself to maintain the panicked expression befitting atrash disciple—only he knew that the trembling was rage, not fear. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang hollowly in his mind: "Be careful, that aura... something's wrong."

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rippled slightly within the Tianji Record) "The venom in those eyes isn't new hatred—it's old resentment accumulated over hundreds of years. Kid, are you certain you've never met this person?"

Chen Ji! Stop standing there in a daze!

Han Lie's booming voice shattered the air like thunder. Golden spiritual light swirled around him, characteristic of the Xuanwu Sect, his battle intent soaring. He slapped away the Demonic Path cultivator before him, crossed the distance in three strides, and stood glaring down at this "trash" with undisguised contempt: "Is the Tianqing Sect so desperate they're sending trash like you to the battlefield? Get to the back! Stop碍手碍脚!"

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his gaze, a faint arc curving his lips. Han Lie's arrival was rather convenient—perfect as a靶子 for experimenting with the Tianji Record's new abilities. He stumbled back two steps on the surface, but secretly channeled spiritual power, activating the fragment he had just unsealed. The Tianji Record's runes glowed faintly in his Mental Sea as a mysterious force spread in all directions—this time, he would excavate all the hidden secrets of the battlefield. Mo Xiansheng had said this page's function was "Retrace Residual Shadows," capable of capturing every thread of cause and effect within half an hour in the area.

dialogue.content: "Retracing Residual Shadows consumes ten points of Heavenly Fate—you're certain you want to do this?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of worry. "Moreover, while casting this technique, your spirit will be exposed for a moment. If detected by a master..."

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer, merely closing his eyes slightly. Heavenly Fate remained at ninety-five points—enough to spare. In an instant, countless faint golden threads appeared floating above the battlefield—those were threads of fate. Every person, every attack on the battlefield was connected by these threads. And among those chaotic threads, Chen Ji saw a bizarre connection: five dim remnant soul lights extending from the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, connecting directly to the Demonic Path Commander! Those were the Five Elders—the remnant divine souls of the five rebel elders from a hundred years ago!

The truth struck like thunder. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply as he witnessed a hair-raising scene: half an hour ago, five remnant souls had quietly awakened from their sealed place and conducted a secret conversation with the Demonic Path Commander. "The new master of the Tianji Record... Chen Xuan's descendant... we cannot let him leave the secret realm alive." That was the voice of the Five Elders' leader, hoarse and icy cold. And the Demonic Path Commander's reply chilled Chen Ji's blood: "Relax, I've waited three hundred and seventy-two years for this."

Three hundred seventy-two years. Chen Ji's heart sank to the depths. Three hundred years ago was precisely the peak era of Chen Xuan, the previous master of the Tianji Record. Which meant this Demonic Path Commander had existed at least since Chen Xuan's era—and his target, from beginning to end, was the Tianji Record. Chen Ji had thought himself the chess master, setting strategies for the world, weaving an unbreakable game. Now he discovered he was merely a piece being repeatedly moved in a grander game. He had spent ten full years scheming the Tianqing Sect's internal chaos, three years infiltrating the three great sects—these supposedly exquisite tactics were, in the eyes of true chess masters, nothing but a ridiculous one-man show.

dialogue.content: Han Lie continued chattering away with mockery beside him, but Chen Ji could no longer hear. Looking at Han Lie's foolish, arrogant face, an absurd sorrow suddenly surged in his heart—this guy probably didn't even know he was being used. "trash! Are you deaf? Get lost!" Han Lie kicked toward Chen Ji.

text.content: Chen Ji grunted, the whole person kicked飞 three zhang away, rolling twice before stopping. A trace of blood stained his lips, which he wiped away with his sleeve, a barely perceptible cold light flickering in his eyes. Surrounding Tianqing Sect disciples showed pity or disdain—only Chen Ji himself knew he had endured this kick willingly. Atrash should look like atrash, shouldn't he? He slowly rose, staggering backward, but silently noted in his heart: Han Lie, every ounce of your arrogance today will become footnotes to your跪地求饶 in the future.

text.content: The instant Han Lie's foot arrived, Chen Ji's body swayed slightly, appearing kicked away while cleverly shedding ninety percent of the force. When landing, he intentionally stumbled, but left a mark on the ground with暗劲—that mark just tripped Han Lie's pursuing foot. The Xuanwu Sect's number one genius stumbled, almost eating dirt, utterly狼狈. Suppressed laughter erupted around, Han Lie's face turned iron-green, finding no reason to flare up. Chen Ji stood with lowered head, his lip arc hidden in shadow: Just testing the waters, Han Lie—why so anxious?

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered as the Tianji Record's power quietly activated. In the next second, something bizarre happened—Han Lie's foot had almost reached Chen Ji, yet his body grotesquely pitched forward, as if shoved by an invisible hand. With a thunderous "砰," the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius crashed face-first, cracking the rocks on the ground. Silence fell instantly, followed by whispered chatter. Han Lie climbed up, face covered in blood, eyes full of disbelief: "Who?! Who's暗算 me?!" No one answered, because everyone thought Han Lie had simply slipped. Chen Ji stood with lowered eyes, heart perfectly calm: This is true碾轧 of cause and effect—making everything look like an accident.

Chen Ji steadied himself, his gaze passing Han Lie's figure to land on the distant black纱-cloaked figure. The Demonic Path Commander seemed to sense his gaze too, a hint of playful amusement flickering in those pitch-black eyes, as if saying: See it now, little one? This is your position on the chessboard. Rage churned in Chen Ji's chest like magma, but his face maintained its cowardly appearance. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea: "Kid, now you understand why the Five Elders wanted to support Ling Yuan's rise, right? Because Ling Yuan was their pawn from the start, and the Tianji Record's inheritor... must die."

dialogue.content: "But you're stronger than they anticipated." Mo Xiansheng's tone carried rare satisfaction. "Three hundred seventy-two years of scheming, they thought victory was assured, yet they didn't know every page awakening of the Tianji Record brings new variables. Did you see the venom in the Demonic Path Commander's eyes? That's hatred for Chen Xuan, also covetousness for the Tianji Record's inheritance. Kid, this game has just begun—what you need to do isn't evade their moves, but overturn the entire chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing that surge of fury. Anger is a weakling's emotion—a chess master isn't blinded by rage. He rapidly analyzed the current situation: the Five Elders' remnants colluding with the Demonic Path Commander,目标是夺取天机录; Ling Yuan was merely their peripheral pawn; the turmoil across the entire cultivation world might be part of this grand game. And himself, thinking he had anticipated everything, actually was just a piece on someone else's board. This realization filled him with suffocating fury, but immediately, a more terrifying calm washed over him: since they wanted to play chess, he would play to the end—who would be the final victor.

At this moment, the Tianji Record's runes suddenly vibrated violently. A will surpassing mortal power pressed down from above the heavens. A cold voice resounded in Chen Ji's mind: "Thou hast peered too deeply." That was the Heavenly Eye's voice—Chen Ji froze instantly, as if plunged into an ice cellar. He had merely used Retrace Residual Shadows to glance at the battlefield, and the Heavenly Eye noticed? What did this mean? It meant the Heavenly Eye's surveillance was omnipresent, meant every use of the Tianji Record was being recorded, and more importantly—maybe the Heavenly Eye was the true幕后黑手 behind all this! The Five Elders' remnants, the Demonic Path Commander, the Tianqing Sect's internal chaos, the cultivation world's great war... could all these conspiracies be merely a chess game set by this "Eye"?

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's oppression descended. Chen Ji had to make a choice before being locked onto.

choices.text: Actively sever the Tianji Record's connection

text.content: Chen Ji decisively severed the Tianji Record's connection. That sensation of being watched vanished instantly. He pretended to rub his eyes nonchalantly, muttering: "Battle's too intense... feeling a bit dizzy..." No one noticed his刚才的异样. That cold will seemed to withdraw as well, but Chen Ji knew it was only temporary. The Heavenly Eye had noticed him—next time he was discovered, it wouldn't end so easily. Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before speaking: "Well done. Survival is the first priority. The game has begun; we both need time to set up."

choices.text: Forcefully resist the Heavenly Eye's gaze
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record fragment as a catalyst, display the bearing of Chen Xuan's inheritor, confront the Heavenly Eye directly.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 points of Heavenly Fate, may suffer heavenly backlash
choices.visible_reward: Declare one's existence to all observers

text.content: Chen Ji did not retreat. Instead, he channeled the Tianji Record to meet that oppression head-on. In an instant, his consciousness seemed to crash against an invisible wall. The Heavenly Eye's will pressed down like something tangible. Violent headache袭来, blood seeped from his nose and ears. But Chen Ji clenched his teeth, refusing to budge even half a step. In his consciousness, he sent out a cold laugh: "So what if you saw? Want to kill me? First ask if the Tianji Record agrees." That will seemed stunned, then receded like a tide. Mo Xiansheng exclaimed: "You're insane?! That's the Heavenly Eye!" Chen Ji grinned, blood staining his teeth: "Insane? I'm perfectly clear-headed. Let it remember me—better than being crushed like an ant."

Whatever choice he made, Chen Ji had already calculated everything in his heart. The Heavenly Eye's appearance let him see a cruel truth: he wasn't fighting the Five Elders' remnants, nor playing games with the Demonic Path Commander—he was waging war against Heaven itself. But this反而 gave Chen Ji an odd sense of relief. Since the opponent was Heaven itself, he had no psychological burden. The Tianji Record was inherently a heaven-defying object—since he chose this path, there was no turning back. Chen Ji scanned the battlefield. Han Lie was still cursing, the Demonic Path Commander had vanished into the chaos, and distant Tianqing Sect disciples were fighting desperately. Everything seemed混乱, but Chen Ji knew this chaos itself was part of the conspiracy. What he needed to do now was find his position in this great upheaval—not as a chess piece, but as the chess master.

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, this time with solemn weight: "Kid, you've discovered this shocking conspiracy, but it's not enough. You need evidence—proof of the Five Elders' remnants colluding with the Demonic Path Commander made public. Only then can you rightfully purge the traitors from the Tianqing Sect, only then can Ling Yuan be utterly disgraced. However, this path carries enormous risk—once you act, they'll perceive your existence." Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, a cold arc curling his lips: "So what if they notice? I never intended to hide. Since they set a three-hundred-year chess game, I'll use thirty years to break the局." His eyes blazed with ambition's fire: "Five Elders' remnants, Demonic Path Commander, Heavenly Eye... fine, let me see—who kills whom first."

On the other side of the battlefield, Han Lie finally noticed Chen Ji's异常. He furrowed his brow, walking over with a puzzled tone: "What was that just now? Why were you standing there in a daze?" Chen Ji gathered his thoughts, switching to a flattering smile: "Reporting to Senior Han, the disciple... disciple was just scared. First time on the battlefield after all..." He deliberately displayed cowardice. Han Liescoffed coldly一声, turned to leave, casting back a final remark: "trash就是trash, don't embarrass yourself next time." Chen Ji lowered his head respectfully, watching him depart. Only he himself knew— the moment Han Lie turned his back, themurderous in Chen Ji's eyes nearly overflowed. Mo Xiansheng sighed: "What do you plan to do about Han Lie?" Chen Ji replied calmly: "Why rush? Let him enjoy himself for now. When the Five Elders' remnants' conspiracy is exposed, the Xuanwu Sect will help me deal with him."
